name: Gordunni Cobalt
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I just arrived here in Feralas, and I've heard that the Gordunni Ogres that inhabit the wilds here have some interesting minerals. Who knows what they are up to, but they sure are protective of that stuff! They don't leave it just lying around; no, they bury it to protect folks like me from getting their hands on it.

If you'd be willing, I'll give you my shovel. Go to the Gordunni Outpost north of here and dig me up some Gordunni cobalt. Look for the blue glow, then start digging!
narrative.objectives: Orwin Gizzmick in Camp Mojache wants 12 samples of Gordunni Cobalt.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Perfect! I will take these along as I continue my travels, adventurer. I'm sure I can find someone that will pay a pretty penny for this cobalt.

Here, take this for your trouble.
narrative.requestItemsText:
Get on up there and start digging!

I've got places to go and people to see -- time is money!
